preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the automatic liquidity addition mechanism. This prevents the contract from converting accumulated fees to liquidity, allowing the owner to later drain accumulated tokens from the contract address. Alternatively, the owner could set the marketing/investing wallets to attacker-controlled addresses to redirect fee distributions.
